name: rentemester-mutation-idempotency-receipts-v20
sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mutation_idempotency_receipts (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  client_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(client_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
  operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(operation) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  workspace_scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(workspace_scope) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096),
  company_scope TEXT,
  actor_scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(actor_scope) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_hash) = 64 AND payload_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('reserved', 'completed')),
  outcome_json TEXT CHECK(outcome_json IS NULL OR (length(outcome_json) <= 65536 AND json_valid(outcome_json))),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  completed_at TEXT,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK((state = 'reserved' AND outcome_json IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (state = 'completed' AND outcome_json IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)),
  UNIQUE(client_key, operation, workspace_scope, company_scope, actor_scope)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS mutation_idempotency_receipts_expiry ON mutation_idempotency_receipts(expires_at);
